event_name: NHRA New England Nationals presented by bproauto

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 64 percent, barometer 29.66 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,104 feet, track temperature 96 degrees.

In 14 meetings with Millican Justin Ashley has "left first" 13 times.  Clay Millican is 21 - 16 in Rd. 1 when
qualified #9.

Ashley is 10 - 4 against Millican in prior events. 

Ashley with the starting line, but was up in smoke and pedaled it.  He lost traction again and the car was
sideways.  Ashley was doing a great job driving it, but couldn't keep it off the centerline.  That will cost
him 10 points.

Millican rattled the tires and did a quick pedal job and got it to hook up enough for the win.

Tony Stewart is 31 - 15 in Rd. 1.  Maddi Gordon's average E/T in Rd. 1 this year is 3.783 

Gordon is 1 - 0 against Stewart in prior events. 

Stewart with a slight starting line advantage, but he is up in smoke by 200 feet and pedaled it.  He couldn't
get it to hook up and clicked it off.

Gordon launched hard and kept it hooked up to make her quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Doug Kalitta has qualified in the top half of the field at 45 of his last 50 races.  Will Smith is making his
10th start

Kalitta is 2 - 0 against Smith in prior events. 

Smith with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke and clicked it off.

Kalitta is straight down the groove with a good pass for the win.

Shawn Langdon has had 2 Bye runs in Rd. 1 this year and went on to win both of those races.  His 24 wins are
11th most in TF history.

Langdon is up smoke early and clicked it off.  He will give up lane choice to Millican in the next round.

Leah Pruett is 7 - 0 in Rd. 1 this year and 16 - 4 in Rd. 1 in her last 20 races.  The #15 TF qualifier has
never won a round at this event.

This is the first time Farley and Pruett have faced each other in eliminations. 

Pruett with the starting line advantage and kept it hooked up for the win.  She will give up lane choice to
Gordon in the next round.

Farley was dropping cylinders right at the hit and was shut off.

In his last 4 races Josh Hart is 1 - 3 in Rd. 1.  This is Rit Pustari's 13th race since 2006

This is the first time Pustari and Hart have faced each other in eliminations. 

Hart with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Pustari lost traction right at the hit and clicked it off.

This is the 34th time (in 81 races) that Shawn Reed has been in the top half of the field.  It's been 25 races
since Antron Brown's last win.

Brown is 5 - 1 against Reed in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line advantage and had the power to hold on for the hole shot win.  He will give up
lane choice to Kalitta in the next round.

Billy Torrence wins 84% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice.  Tony Schumacher is 1 - 5 against Torrence
in Rd. 1

Torrence is 7 - 4 against Schumacher in prior events. 

They have identical reaction times and are together until Schumacher starts to smoke the tires.  Torrence
started to haze the tires around half track and drop cylinders.  He stayed with for the win.  He will give up
lane choice to Hart in the next round.
